checked_obligation: Verify that equation (1) rewrites as quadratic (2) in m and that any integral root forces discriminant condition (3).
reason: Collecting the terms of (1) by powers of m gives m^2+(1-4n)m+(n^2+n)=0. Its discriminant is (1-4n)^2-4(n^2+n)=12n^2-12n+1. If m is an integer root, then the discriminant equals (2m+1-4n)^2, so it is a perfect square; for positive integer n it is positive, hence t>0 may be chosen. The supplied quotient and isomorphism rules are unrelated and unnecessary.
